headline: Steady revenue growth with a clear profit step-up
summary_short: Revenue was SEK 21,306M, up 7.3% y/y and 2.9% q/q; operating income rose 11.0% y/y to SEK 4,426M and EPS was SEK 0.69.
summary_long: Net income rose 21.3% q/q to SEK 2,704M and EPS rose 21.1% q/q. Gross profit was SEK 13,651M, up 3.1% y/y. Reported figures include acquisitions and currency effects, so the y/y revenue growth is not like for like. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Two web searches did not surface the October 22, 2026 interim report (only earlier reports and a pre-report estimates table). Figures are Yahoo fundamentals-timeseries, reported not like-for-like, and not reconciled to adjusted EBITDA.
